answer: Counterparty diversity blocks sybil merchants using self-trading puppets. Each epoch an identity must buy from 50 distinct counterparties; a scanner rejects self-trades. Verified sets earn a bright reputation plume. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 50,000 real trades per epoch: $2 each burns $100,000 per epoch, linear per fake, vs $100 once for the honest. Rejected trades enter the sable ledger. Honest merchants already use many partners, so it costs them nothing — and the shared vault is no longer diluted by idle puppets.
